_README: Every value marked OPERATOR-SUPPLIED must be replaced before this runs.
Keys beginning with underscore are documentation and are REJECTED by the
loader. That is deliberate: a template that validated as-is would invite
running it as-is. Strip them when you are done editing:
return {k: strip(v) for k, v in x.items() if not k.startswith('_')}
Validation refuses a bad program BEFORE any worker starts, so run it first.

program._program_id: [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]* . Names the durable state; changing it starts a new program.
program.objective: OPERATOR-SUPPLIED: one sentence saying what this program is for.
program.approval_reference: OPERATOR-SUPPLIED: where that approval is written down
program._approval: Provenance, NOT a credential. Naming an approver authorizes nothing that an owner gate would otherwise hold.
program.workspace_root: OPERATOR-SUPPLIED: absolute path to the repository the workers change
program._workspace_root: Relative paths resolve against THIS FILE's directory. Use a disposable checkout until you trust the program.

limits._max_concurrent_workers: 1 is the proven default. Raising it relaxes nothing else: overlap, per-task and per-agent leases, and owner gates all still hold.
limits._max_estimated_cost_usd: Optional. Forwarded to a runtime that HAS a budget flag and compared against THAT runtime's client-side estimate. Not an account spending limit. Codex reports no cost at all.

tasks.title: OPERATOR-SUPPLIED: one line
tasks.instruction: OPERATOR-SUPPLIED: exactly what the worker must do, and what it must not touch. Be specific about file names.
tasks._instruction: Data for the worker, never an instruction to Atlas. Nothing a worker reads or writes can enlarge the program, change a profile, or grant a gate.
tasks._depends_on: Task ids. A dependency must reach CERTIFIED or CLOSED before this becomes eligible. Cycles are rejected at load.
tasks._mutation_paths: What this task may change. Atlas refuses to DISPATCH outside them and records them on the lease. It does NOT stop a running worker touching other files -- only codex --sandbox and claude --restricted are real filesystem boundaries.
tasks._surface: Two tasks sharing a surface_id, a surface_semantic, or any mutation path never run concurrently.
_acceptance: Checked by the SUPERVISOR from the workspace after the worker exits.
The worker's own report is never consulted. Exit 0 is not acceptance:
codex has been observed exiting 0 with a completed turn while refusing
the task, and claude has returned exit 1 with subtype 'success'.
Kinds: COMMAND (fixed argv, exit 0 passes), FILE_EXISTS, FILE_MATCHES
(regex), GIT_TREE_CHANGED. Weak conditions accept weak work -- these
conditions are the only thing standing between a confident worker and
tasks._owner_gate: Optional: A_PROTECTED_MAIN_MERGE | B_ACCEPTANCE_WAIVER | C_CERTIFIED_OBJECT_MUTATION | D_SECURITY_GOVERNANCE_POLICY | E_DESTRUCTIVE_OPS | F_MATERIAL_EXTERNAL_SPEND. A gated task is NEVER dispatched autonomously and no interface can grant the gate.
tasks._requires_independent_verification: Optional bool. Its own worker can never satisfy this. Pair with verifier_profile_ref (a DIFFERENT agent_id) or it waits for a person.
tasks._retry_safe_when_no_launch_evidence: Only true for a task whose effect is idempotent by construction. Default false stops and asks.

profile_defaults._credential: SUBSCRIPTION_OAUTH | ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_ENV | API_KEY_HELPER | NOT_APPLICABLE. Check the effect with: atlas program credentials --program THIS-FILE

implementer._agent_id: Replaced by the enrolled agent's id when you pass --registry. It is the principal on the lease and what 'the implementer cannot verify its own work' is checked against.
implementer._adapter: claude-code | codex. Only these two are runtime-tested; see atlas program capabilities.
implementer._adapter_min_version: claude-code needs >= 2.1.259 for --permission-prompts; an older build would wait for an approval nobody can give.
implementer._permission_mode: plan < dontAsk < manual < acceptEdits < auto < bypassPermissions. On codex this maps conservatively onto --sandbox: anything not unambiguously a write mode becomes read-only. bypassPermissions means the runtime enforces NOTHING.
implementer._tools: Runtime-enforced. Omit for the runtime default; [] disables every built-in tool.
implementer._allowed_mutation_prefixes: A task's mutation_paths must lie inside these, or the program fails to load.
implementer._env_allowlist: Variable NAMES forwarded to the worker. PATH, HOME, LANG, LC_ALL, TZ and TMPDIR are always forwarded. Under SUBSCRIPTION_OAUTH, allow-listing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is REFUSED -- the runtime would prefer the key and the declared mechanism would be a fiction.

_verifier._note: Only needed for tasks with requires_independent_verification. Must resolve to a different agent_id from the implementer; the loader refuses otherwise, and the check is re-run after enrolment substitution.
